references.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
references.title: CCR2 chemokine receptor signaling mediates pain in experimental osteoarthritis.
references.note: mouse knee OA (DMM): CCL2/CCR2 up in the knee-innervating DRG and needed for movement-provoked pain (covers the receptor's signalling steps by extension)

references.title: Molecular insights into ligand recognition and activation of chemokine receptors CCR2 and CCR3.
references.note: cryo-EM of the human CCL2-CCR2-G protein complex: receptor-Galpha contacts, ICL2 critical for G protein activation

references.title: The chemokine CCL2 increases Nav1.8 sodium channel activity in primary sensory neurons through a Gβγ-dependent mechanism.
references.note: rat DRG neurons: the CCL2 effect is pertussis toxin sensitive, i.e. CCR2 acts through Gi/o in sensory neurons

references.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
references.title: CCR2 chemokine receptor signaling mediates pain in experimental osteoarthritis.
references.note: mouse knee OA (DMM): CCR2 signalling in the knee-innervating DRG drives OA pain (covers the G protein cycle of this receptor by extension)

references.title: Molecular insights into ligand recognition and activation of chemokine receptors CCR2 and CCR3.
references.note: human CCR2-G protein complex: the receptor's intracellular loop 2 contacts are the ones that matter for G protein activation (functional assays alongside the structure)

references.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
references.title: Mapping allosteric connections from the receptor to the nucleotide-binding pocket of heterotrimeric G proteins.
references.note: EPR on Gi alpha with activated rhodopsin: the receptor-bound heterotrimer empties its nucleotide pocket (receptor-catalysed exchange); recombinant Gi, bovine rhodopsin

references.title: G proteins: transducers of receptor-generated signals.
references.note: no abstract in PubMed; classic review of the G protein cycle: the activated receptor catalyses GDP release and GTP binding on the alpha subunit

references.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
references.title: CCR2 chemokine receptor signaling mediates pain in experimental osteoarthritis.
